name: yokai
description: A sarcastic yokai that counts your project's failed terminal commands in a band above the prompt. It spends no tokens and leaves on its own after 7 quiet days.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Language of the yokai's texts: en, es, fr, de, pt, ja or zh (pt-BR also works). Translations ship with the plugin in locales/, so choosing one costs no tokens and makes no model call. An unknown code stays in English.
